name: adhesaplate
description: Adhesa Plate website and client-side apps, deployed to Cloudflare Workers

scripts.check: npm run check -w website && npm run line-endings:check
scripts.preview:site: npm run build:site && npx wrangler@4.129.0 dev -c wrangler.site.jsonc
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && npx wrangler@4.129.0 whoami && npx wrangler@4.129.0 deploy -c wrangler.site.jsonc
